recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not rename current Dosage.site or MedicationAdministration.dosage.site for this historical MedicationStatement issue unless Pharmacy makes a new explicit decision to change the shared dosage naming model.
issue_request: FHIR-7647 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy issue asking to rename MedicationStatement.dosage.site to administrationSite. The final resolution instead directed changing the element to point to a CodeableConcept or reference to a resource for consistency across medication resources.
initial_application: Commit adae3b44d38345163adcc08c480d717a2bfe461f explicitly applied #7647 by changing MedicationStatement.dosage.site to MedicationStatement.dosage.site[x] and changing the type from CodeableConcept to CodeableConcept | Reference(BodySite), while leaving the element name as site. Later commit 1d00edee4413c641918bdf96071c2407902bc4c3 refactored MedicationStatement dosage handling into shared dosage-instruction structures that preserved the coded-or-referenced site semantics.
additional_context: Current source has MedicationStatement.dosage as type DosageDetails with no MedicationStatement-local dosage.site or administrationSite child. The active shared Dosage.site row is CodeableReference(BodyStructure), keeps the MedicationAdministrationSite binding, and describes a coded or referenced anatomic site. Later issue FHIR-54848, already represented on the combined branch, reconciled the current Dosage.site BodyStructure guidance. Focused Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later core decision requiring an administrationSite rename.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current spec is already correct for FHIR-7647 because the final modified representation request is satisfied by the current shared dosage model, and renaming current site elements would go beyond the Jira resolution.
